description: Prove the complete installation lifecycle on a disposable remote host before any household deployment is eligible.
acceptance: A clean disposable host is preflighted, planned, explicitly approved, bootstrapped, started, inventoried, diagnosed, and verified through supported service APIs.
The proof confirms pinned images, protected credentials, correct ownership and mounts, actual hardlink feasibility, healthy service wiring, restart policy, and recovery after a controlled reboot.
Stale plan, wrong host identity, unavailable backup, unauthorized sudo, failed readiness, and destructive cleanup requests fail closed without partial green claims.
Rollback and teardown remove only exact marked resources and leave zero matching containers, networks, volumes, runtime directories, or remote deployment residue.
